title_original: Johnny Depp Premieres ‘Ebenezer’ in London, Kim Kardashian Wears Gucci to LACMA Art+Film and More Celeb Red Carpet Photos: November 2026

blocks.text: November began with a slew of award season FYC screenings and Q&As in Los Angeles, including a round of appearances from Jordan Firstman in support of his feature “Club Kid” and an Angelina Jolie-hosted “Wild Horse Nine” premiere in Los Angeles.

In New York City, Kim Kardashian, Sarah Paulson, Teyana Taylor, Niecy Nash-Betts and Glenn Close stunned on the red carpet at the “All’s Fair” Season 2 premiere. Meanwhile, Allison Janney glowed in a Christian Siriano gown at the CFDA Awards.
See the best celebrity red-carpet and event photos from November 2026 below. Keep checking back all month long for more.
